fields.name: external_id
fields.description: Stable identifier of the asset in the source system. Used as the idempotency key for writes.

fields.name: species
fields.description: Common English name of the tree species, e.g. 'London planetree'. Empty for stumps and dead trees.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether the tree is alive, a stump, or standing dead.

fields.name: condition
fields.description: Inspector's health rating. Only recorded for living trees.

fields.name: diameter_cm
fields.description: Trunk diameter in centimeters, measured at breast height (1.37 m above the ground).

fields.name: borough
fields.description: New York City borough where the asset is located.

fields.name: inspected_on
fields.description: Date the asset was last inspected.
